recording_ref.description: An opaque recording-manifest reference, never opened as a path here.

boundary.description:
Some applies only to capture at/after this sample boundary. None is an
explicit retroactive retranslation of this session's current sources.

status.description: None means capture registered but no ASR result has been committed.

body.description: Internal event data only. Never forward this as a public projection.

ProducerRecoveryEvidence.description:
Host-only evidence. Boolean assertions must come from owned process cleanup
and a fully acknowledged producer outbox, never from untrusted node claims.

final_seq.description: Last durable sequence BEFORE this seal; seal itself uses final_seq + 1.

sources.description: Every registered capture, including missing, empty and failed ASR.

payload.description:
For a human revision, backend/model fields retain the original ASR
provenance; `origin` identifies who produced this revision's text.
